title: Chain
description: A settlement domain with its own address format. NOT MODELLED AS AN ENTITY: apps/api/internal/accounts/wallets/wallets.go validates against an inline table of 7 chains (ethereum, bsc, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, base, solana) and refuses CEX names as chains ('a CEX account is an IOU on a venue, not a chain address', objective 8.20); apps/api/internal/finance/transactions/transactions.go carries Chain as an UNCONSTRAINED string with a default of 'Offchain'; apps/reconciler/src/chains.rs holds a third, private registry enriched with RPC endpoints, token ids and the LLAMA_IDS price mapping. Two of those three disagree, which is why the canonical chain_id is required.

name.description: Lowercase canonical label as wallets.go stores it (e.g. 'ethereum').

chain_numeric_id.description: EVM chain id, as DefiLlama's LlamaChain.chainId carries it; null for non-EVM.
